name: Vendor eForm Intake
description: Procurement collects a vendor's details on an eForm: Fill Form gives the requester the Vendor Onboarding eForm beside the incoming document and keeps the filled form in a Document variable; Edit Form reopens that filled eForm for corrections.

steps.name: Fill the vendor form
steps.instructions: Fill in the vendor's details and save.

steps.name: Correct the vendor form
steps.instructions: Check the vendor's details and correct them.
